page_title: WOL 1-1 DOR | Wolfsburg v Dortmund 17/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+9' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the free kick, but it sails wide of the target. The goalkeeper didn't have to react at all.
90+8' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Youssoufa Moukoko (Dortmund) receives a yellow card!
90+8' Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) receives a yellow card.
90+7' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
90+5' Wolfsburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+2' Chance! Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
90+1' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Dortmund comes to nothing.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' The ball spins out to Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) and his swerving volley from the edge of the box flashes just over the bar.
88' Substitution. Amin Sarr (Wolfsburg) on for Jonas Wind.
86' Half-chance! Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg) plays a pass into the box, but Gregor Kobel reacts well to snuff out the attack.
85' Edin Terzic has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Youssoufa Moukoko (Dortmund) replacing Niclas Fullkrug.
84' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
79' The game is interrupted now, Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
79' Here's the change. Jadon Sancho leaves the pitch and Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) comes on as a substitute.
79' Substitution. Marco Reus will be replaced by Salih Ozcan (Dortmund).
77' Niko Kovac has decided to substitute Kevin Behrens and he is replaced by Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg).
77' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Dortmund was in an offside position.
73' Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Martin Petersen blows his whistle for a foul.
71' Martin Petersen shows the yellow card to Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) for a heavy challenge.
67' One of the players from Wolfsburg times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
66' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) is adjudged offside.
64' 1 - 1 Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) gets to the rebound in the goalmouth and plants a header home.
63' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) produces a clever header from around the penalty spot, but it's stopped by one of the defending players.
63' Wolfsburg earn a corner.
62' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
62' Wolfsburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
62' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) hits an explosive shot from outside the penalty area and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save. The ball is out of play and Wolfsburg manage to earn a corner.
61' Ian Maatsen (Dortmund) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
59' Maxence Lacroix (Wolfsburg) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Martin Petersen blows his whistle for a foul.
57' Everything seems to be alright after the game was interrupted, the referee blows his whistle and the match can continue.
53' The game is interrupted.
49' Dortmund can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

48' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Koen Casteels makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! Corner kick. Dortmund will have an opportunity.
46' Niko Kovac has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) comes on the pitch for Mattias Svanberg.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+13' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+9' Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
45+8' OFF THE POST! Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot which smashes against the right post.
45+6' The free kick is delivered by Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
45+5' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Dortmund was in an offside position.
45+4' Wolfsburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
45' There will be a minimum of 12 min. of added time.
44' Everything seems to be alright after the game was interrupted, the referee blows his whistle and the match can continue.
43' The game is interrupted.
39' The game gets underway again after that interruption.
35' The game is interrupted.
31' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
28' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the left post.
27' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
26' Marco Reus (Dortmund) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
25' Referee Martin Petersen sees the trip by Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Dortmund are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
24' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Gregor Kobel, who smothers the ball.
23' Marco Reus (Dortmund) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
22' Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
22' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range low towards the middle of the net, but Koen Casteels was alert and made an amazing save!
19' The match can continue after the interruption.
17' The game is interrupted.
16' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
15' Everything seems to be alright after the game was interrupted, the referee blows his whistle and the match can continue.
13' The game is interrupted.
11' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
8' 0 - 1 Goal! Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 0:1.
8' Marco Reus (Dortmund) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Koen Casteels.
7' The corner is swung in but Dortmund can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
7' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Dortmund.
5' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort well wide of the right post.
4' Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Gregor Kobel has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
3' Wolfsburg are ruled offside.
2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Wolfsburg.

2' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Wolfsburg have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Dortmund will take the kick-off.
Martin Petersen is introduced as the referee for today's match.
